research.title: Transactions
research.implication: A read transaction presents one historical snapshot; starting it before metadata attestation keeps subsequent reads in the same database view.

research.title: Isolation In SQLite
research.implication: Separate connections can observe different committed states; an explicit read transaction closes the attestation-to-read race.

research.title: The Schema Table
research.implication: sqlite_schema is ordinary queryable catalog state and must be schema-qualified when TEMP shadowing is in scope.

research.title: PRAGMA trusted_schema
research.implication: Turning trusted_schema off is defense in depth against application-defined functions or virtual tables embedded in schema expressions.

research.title: PRAGMA schema_version
research.implication: The schema cookie is a change signal, not a cryptographic or semantic commitment to exact DDL.

research.title: sqlite3_set_authorizer
research.implication: An authorizer constrains operations during preparation but does not replace exact schema/data attestation.
